# Every assertion reads the live Rust terminal, not text echoed by this script.
sample
assert-size 40 8
assert-line 0 red green
assert-fg 0 0 1
assert-fg 4 0 2
assert-cell 1 1 😀
assert-width 1 1 1
assert-cell 2 1 界
assert-width 2 1 2
assert-cell 4 1 e\u0301
assert-line 2 cursor: XYZ
assert-cursor 11 2
input hi\r\uD800
assert-output hi\r\uD800
reset
assert-line 0 
assert-cursor 0 0
resize 8 4
write abcdefghijkl\r\n
assert-line 0 abcdefgh
assert-line 1 ijkl
assert-cursor 0 2
resize 12 4
assert-size 12 4
assert-line 0 abcdefghijkl
assert-line 1 
assert-cursor 0 1
serialize
show
quit
